posts.text:
Fired OpenAI researchers say they lost jobs for putting safety first

Mikita Balesni, Tomek Korbak and Jasmine Wang published a letter saying OpenAI fired them for prioritising safety, while the company says they mishandled sensitive information.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-fired-researchers-letter/

Alibaba releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-step image model with open weights

The 7-billion-parameter checkpoint makes 2K images and edits them in eight denoising steps, and Alibaba's Qwen team says quality does not drop.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-qwen-image-21-turbo/

Simon Willison builds a blog feature by voice with Codex while cooking dinner

The developer talked a Django Newsletters page into existence with the ChatGPT desktop app's Codex tab, then spent another half hour typing fixes.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-simonw-voice-codex-blog/

Google tests an Ultra mode in AI Studio Build, TestingCatalog reports

TestingCatalog says the unannounced mode sits beside Plan, Build and Security review, and may be meant to work with Google's upcoming Gemini 4 Argon.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-google-ai-studio-ultra-mode/

Open-source Bigarrow lets coding agents draw a giant arrow on your Mac screen

The MIT-licensed macOS tool paints an arrow, box or sign over a button so an agent can show you where to click, and it never clicks, types or captures anything itself.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-bigarrow-agent-pointer/

AI executives are gaming out a political revolt after a catastrophe, Axios says
https://theaipost.net/story/axios-ai-execs-backlash-planning/

Hugging Face TRL v1.15 cuts training memory by up to 82%
https://theaipost.net/story/find-trl-v1-15-fused-lm-head/

Meta's Wang marks a month of Muse as agent privacy design comes under scrutiny

Alexandr Wang says Muse, Meta's always-on agent, runs in its own secure VM, with a sentinel agent that blocks card and Social Security numbers, a month after launch.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-muse-month-one-agent-privacy/

Anthropic is hiring a lead to teach 2028 presidential candidates about AI
https://theaipost.net/story/anthropic-presidential-engagement-2028/

Nvidia engineers use GPT-6 Astra to build robot and driving simulators

Nvidia says its own engineers had OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra build a humanoid warehouse sim, a Market Street driving test bed and a browser view of the International Space Station.

https://theaipost.net/story/cbaf7193e/

SpaceXAI gives Omarchy $1.5 million in Grok tokens to review its code

Omarchy's founder says Grok 4.7 will power Omabot, the agent reviewing pull requests as the Linux distro nears 7,000 of them from 550 contributors.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-spacexai-omarchy-grok-tokens/

Goodfire says probes inside AI models can police agents for $185 a million exchanges

The startup says its monitors caught 93% of malicious hacking sessions on Kimi K3, against $200,000 for a top-tier AI checker doing the same watch.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-goodfire-inside-out-monitors/

California orders robot fighting league Rek to stop matches involving humans

The state athletic commission sent a cease-and-desist after a September human-versus-robot bout, and Rek's next fight pits two armed robots against each other.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-rek-california-robot-fights/

Pocketty puts an iPhone SSH terminal in front of blocked coding agents

A new iPhone and iPad app pings you when a coding agent is stuck and opens a live terminal to answer it, for a one-off $99 launch price.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-pocketty-agent-terminal/

Open-source Jevman benchmark has AI models play Pac-Man against the ghosts

Opper AI's Jevman asks a model for a direction probability at every junction, with two seconds to answer, across 100 recorded games per model.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-jevman-pacman-benchmark/

Anthropic opens free open-source bug scans and a critical infrastructure program
https://theaipost.net/story/find-anthropic-cyber-mission/

Open-source Atomic Agent runs local models and borrows your Claude Code setup

The MIT-licensed agent, with a desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux, says it beat Hermes on a GAIA test using the same local Qwen model.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-atomic-agent-desktop/
